relations.rationale: Ivo's finishing position relative to Kira has no bearing on Noor's robot's paint color.
Ivo finishing ahead of Kira suggests some performance difference, which weakly conflicts with the claim that their designs performed equally well.
Adjusting the robot's wheels after a collision aligns with wanting to improve balance for the next round.
Kira adjusting her robot's wheels has no direct bearing on her finishing position relative to Nell.
Kira finishing ahead of Nell in a race is unrelated to their relative ages.
Kira finishing ahead of Nell says nothing about how her design compared to Ivo's in trials.
Nell being younger than Leo doesn't determine her age relative to Kira.
Nell being younger than Leo supports the idea that Leo could be the oldest participant.
Nell's age relative to Leo has no bearing on the group gathering to compare notes and pack up.
Ivo being taller than Nell doesn't establish anything about his height relative to Noor.
Leo being the oldest participant supports the plausibility of him helping newer, presumably younger, members.
Leo being the oldest has no bearing on whether Noor's robot was easy to spot.
Leo's age status is unrelated to the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's robot designs.
Leo helping newer members solder wires has no bearing on Noor's robot's paint color.
Leo spending part of the afternoon helping others is consistent with and supports the broader claim that everyone gathered together at the end.
Noor's robot being bright yellow directly supports it being easy to spot among others.
Kira's design using fewer parts than Ivo's is consistent with and supports the claim that both designs still worked equally well despite the difference.
